# Little Kit

## Overview

- **Age:** Infant (born at the end of Vol. 4)  <sub>[v4 c19 P1](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0001), [v4 c23 P0](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c19 P1](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0001)</sub>
- **Origin:** House of Dreams, Seven Gulls Harbor, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c34 P0](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Little Kit  <sub>[v4 c19 P5](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0005)</sub>; James Obed Carrow  <sub>[v4 c19 P21](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0021)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Little Kit  <sub>[v4 c19 P5](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

He is a healthy, ten-pound baby with pale skin, dark hazel eyes, and soft red curly hair. He has a forehead that resembles his father's, smooth and delicate ears, and well-formed hands and feet.

_Sources: [v4 c19 P6](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0006), [v4 c19 P14](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0014), [v4 c19 P16](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0016), [v4 c19 P24](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0024), [v4 c23 P0](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0000), [v4 c34 P6](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0006)_

## Personality

He is a healthy, vocal baby with strong lungs who cries when taken from his mother and is easily cheered by her presence.

_Sources: [v4 c19 P6](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0006), [v4 c19 P14](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0014)_

## History

Little Kit is born on a June morning at the house of dreams to Nell and Hugh Carrow after a brief and smooth delivery. His parents name him James Obed Carrow after Captain Saul Garrick and Obed Abernethy, though he is affectionately called Little Kit. In his early months, he thrives under the care of his mother, father, and Tabitha, adored by family friends like Captain Saul, Lorna, and Miss Winifred.

_Sources: [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c19 P1](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0001), [v4 c19 P6](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0006), [v4 c19 P21](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0021), [v4 c19 P28](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0028), [v4 c23 P0](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0000), [v4 c25 P1](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0001)_
